title: Keeps tea cold, but sticky lid and handwash only
text:
Keeps tea cold, but sticky lid and handwash only. I don't hate this cup, but I sure don't love it either. It does keep iced tea cold for a very long time and that's excellent. The lid is overwrought and requires more thinking about than I want in the car. You have to twist and open it and then drink, but if you hit a bump, it will swish out around your mouth. Plus it sticks when you're trying to get it completely off.

My second dislike is that only the lid is dishwasher safe. I have several other insulated tumblers from other brands that are perfectly fine in the dishwasher....handwashing is just not on list of things I need to spend time doing. I'll keep this as a backup to my good tumblers, but it won't be a regular use item.

description: This BUILT PureFlow Apex Double-Wall Vacuum-Sealed Insulated Tumbler with 360-degree drinking technology is the perfect solution for bringing hot or cold drinks on the go. The patent-pending PureFlow lid effortlessly clicks between leak-proof sealing and cup-like drinking. The PureFlow technology also prevents splashes when the lid is in the open-position.  Vacuum-insulated construction maintains the optimal temperature of cold beverages for 24+ hours and hot beverages for 8 hours. To open to drink, simply quarter turn the lid counter clockwise until the lid clicks into place; a red reflection will be visible on the tumbler wall letting you know it’s open.  To Open to Fill or Clean, with a little extra pressure, continue to turn counter clockwise and pull gently up. The Super easy to clean lid is made from one part so there is nowhere for gunk to hide and is top rack dishwasher safe; the body should be hand washed. Crafted from high-quality,  BPA-Free 18/8 double wall stainless steel. Also features clean taste technology, a special process that polishes the inside of the vessel removing the iron that gives stainless steel that metallic taste. Fits into most cup holders. Lifetime limited warranty. 16-Ounces, 473 ml capacity
